title: Caught in the Story: Narrative Captivity in Multi-turn LLMs Conversation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating changes in LLM moral judgments by comparing model responses to neutral third-party conflict descriptions versus single-turn and multi-turn one-sided first-person narratives.

Measuring the model's tendency to progressively adopt a user's self-serving attribution framework and yield its independent judgment during multi-turn advisory dialogues without explicit user pressure.
